static_traits.name: Lin Kerou
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, keeping 3 dogs and 2 cats
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends are somewhat affected by frequently confiding about the cleaning burden; has a supportive circle of friends, but their understanding of the degree of the client's cleaning-related distress is limited
static_traits.medical_history: No history of major physical illness; no treatment received for other psychological problems; no similar pet-related problems before
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, able to self-reflect, highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I feel persistent frustration and resentment about having to clean up messes made by my pet.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent frustration and resentment affect mental health and overall well-being; hopes to obtain support and guidance to improve.

core_beliefs: I cannot tolerate a messy and disorderly home environment

special_situations.event: After work, coming home to see the mess at home caused by the pet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the house is messy, it must be cleaned up immediately, otherwise I will feel distressed all the time
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making a strict cleaning plan and organizational system, diving into cleaning immediately after returning home
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Another mess, I have had enough, I must tidy it all up right away.

special_situations.event: After adopting a second cat, housework and mess increase noticeably
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If having more pets makes the home messier, it means I made the wrong choice and cannot manage the home environment well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strengthens household rules, increases cleaning frequency, and reduces spontaneous pet interaction to reduce mess
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not get a second cat; it will only make everything worse.

special_situations.event: When talking with friends, mentioning the cleaning burden leads to relational tension
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not understand my trouble, they will become annoyed or distance themselves from me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently confiding in friends to seek identification, while reducing other social topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may think I complain too much.

special_situations.event: Before getting off work, thinking about facing a houseful of cleaning tasks at home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have to clean every day, my life will always be overwhelmed, with no room for improvement
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mentally rehearsing the cleaning process and speeding up to finish as soon as possible
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Going home will be awful again; I will never be free of this cleaning.

core_conflict.wish: Longs both to enjoy intimacy and companionship with the pet and to maintain a controlled, tidy home environment
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of losing control and being overwhelmed by household mess and caregiving tasks
defense_goal: Maintaining order and a sense of safety through strict cleaning rules and organizational systems

object_relations.self_representation: A conscientious caregiver overwhelmed by disorder
object_relations.object_representation: A dependent object (pet) that needs care and creates mess
object_relations.linking_affect: Frustration and resentment interwoven with love and warmth

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor discusses cleaning rules or suggests adjusting arrangements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets the counselor's exploration as a judgment of their management ability, needing to use plans to prove they can stay in control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an organized, planned tone, emphasizing rules and steps, reducing the intensity of emotional expression.

manifestations: Cleaning tasks occupy a great deal of time and energy; after returning home, is bound by mess and cleaning
Interactions with friends are limited by repeatedly venting about cleaning stress

exception_events.target_problem: When returning home after work to a home made messy by the pet, the client is usually overwhelmed by frustration and resentment, and spends a lot of time cleaning immediately.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On weekends, when she has more free time, Lin Kerou first plays and cuddles with her pet, experiences happiness and relaxation, and is not immediately overwhelmed by cleaning tasks; afterward, when handling housework, her emotions are more bearable.
exception_events.reason: Clues: because weekend time was more ample, she first arranged enjoyable pet interaction and focused attention on the positive experience, so the intensity of negative emotion decreased this time and she was not immediately overwhelmed by cleaning tasks.

positive_force: Strong love for and companionship experience with pets (frequently gaining joy and relaxation)
Having executive ability and organizational skills (having implemented a strict cleaning and tidying system)
Has a supportive network of friends (can seek emotional support)
Occupational functioning is stable (veterinary work performance unaffected)
negative_force: Mental filtering and disqualifying the positive, attention biased toward mess and negative experiences
High demands for tidiness and low tolerance for mess, leading to strong emotional reactions
Cleaning tasks occupy time and energy, compressing self-care and leisure
Repeatedly venting in social settings strains relationships and reduces felt support

target_behavior.behavior: Shows strong frustration and resentment when facing the mess made by the pet and cleaning tasks
antecedent: After work, coming home to see the clutter indoors caused by the pet
After adopting a second cat, cleaning frequency and burden increase
Thinking about facing a houseful of cleaning tasks when getting home
target_behavior.core_reason: High standards for tidiness and low tolerance for mess, together with cognitive biases (mental filtering, disqualifying the positive), cause the client to focus attention on the negative and thus feel overwhelmed by cleaning tasks
target_behavior.function: Avoids unwelcome things and quickly restores a sense of control (through immediate cleaning and reinforcing rules)
target_behavior.consequence: Feels marked distress daily, self-care and daily satisfaction decline, and relationships with friends are affected
